newsitem.title: UK: INSIGHT -FTSE to recover to 4915 then slip to 4870.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT -FTSE to recover to 4915 then slip to 4870.

text.p: The FTSE 100 index may attempt a recovery process on Monday but will have difficulty going beyond 4,915 before downward pressure takes it towards 4,870, technical analysts said.

It has lost the fluency and upward motion from earlier last week but by securing a foothold around the 4,890 market, bulls may be able to restore some pride and hope by at least making a stand near last week's closing levels.
Re-positioning of portfolios will be inevitable as investors take profits following a fall from an intra-day high of 4,936 on Friday. By 0723 GMT, the index was indicated up 2.1 at 4,901.4.
On Friday, the FTSE fell below an upward trending channel to be lured back to seek support near its 10-day moving average.
This channel had been developing over most of last week and allowed for the index to fidget within a daily range of 60 points.

But the thrills and spills of Friday shattered investor confidence, meaning erratic movements will be the norm over the short-term as the market comes to terms with weakened conditions begun on Friday, analysts said.
